_about: Where the Santa hat sits on each cover photo's snake (Christmas preview). Key: the photo's file stem (species-photos/hero/<stem>-<width>.webp) or its data-photo-id. x, y: the middle of the hat's fur brim, as parts of the photo's width and height; w: the brim's width as a part of the photo's width; a: its turn in degrees (+ = clockwise, on screen); flip: true when the snake looks left (the hat's tip then falls to the right, behind its head). A photo with no entry gets no hat. To add a photo: put it in species-photos/hero/, add its stem here (read x, y off the photo: the crown of the head just behind the eye), run python3 tools/build-christmas.py and check it with a zoomed screenshot at desktop and phone sizes.
